"import csv
from collections import defaultdict
from openpyxl import Workbook


def main():
    # Read the long-format CSV
    values = defaultdict(list)  # (config, channel) -> list of raw measured values
    configs = set()
    channels = set()

    with open("eng_pivot_04.csv", newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
        reader = csv.DictReader(f)
        for row in reader:
            config = row["config"].strip()
            channel = row["channel"].strip()
            value = float(row["value"])  # keep raw value, no pre-rounding
            values[(config, channel)].append(value)
            configs.add(config)
            channels.add(channel)

    sorted_configs = sorted(configs)
    sorted_channels = sorted(channels)

    # Build workbook
    wb = Workbook()
    ws = wb.active
    ws.title = "SUMMARY"

    # Header row: "config" + sorted channel names
    ws.append(["config"] + sorted_channels)

    # One row per config (sorted ascending); cell = max of raw values, rounded to 3 decimals
    for cfg in sorted_configs:
        out_row = [cfg]
        for ch in sorted_channels:
            vals = values.get((cfg, ch))
            if vals:
                out_row.append(round(max(vals), 3))
            else:
                out_row.append(None)
        ws.append(out_row)

    wb.save("output.xlsx")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()"
